mission_result: Worker depth should be governed by causal continuity and authority/context safety, not an arbitrary task count. A worker continues while the next checkpoint is sequential, acceptance-relevant, within the same authority/write envelope, benefits from the current Working Set, and does not require independent judgment. It splits when fresh independence, different owner/authority/privacy scope, collision isolation, different capability, substantial context reset or genuine parallel speedup creates value. After any RETURN, further work in the same chat requires a fresh allocation/claim/run; prior authority never leaks forward. This prevents both shallow one-file stopping and unsafe universal mega-workers.

checkpoint_completion.finding: Binding laws already require acceptance-driven continuation, fresh critics where independence matters, <=10-minute target durable liveness, and POST_RETURN reallocation rather than arbitrary stopping.
Defined hard CONTINUE/SPLIT predicates, separate-run post-return chaining and a concrete checkpoint receipt.
Defined canaries that fail shallow early RETURN, leaked authority across tasks, self-evaluation at fresh-critic boundaries and needless serialization.

This recovery chat itself followed the safe post-return pattern once already: first recovery completed RETURN+DONE, then live state was reloaded and this separate stale opportunity received its own recovery claim and STARTED run rather than reusing the prior claim. This is supportive evidence for the chaining shape, not a full canary proof.

evidence.observed: Binding work-depth law says continue sequential same-context/same-authority work, inspect/persist/check acceptance after each checkpoint, re-enter allocation after RETURN, and split only when parallelism/independence/capability/ownership/context/collision/failure isolation adds value.

Binding work-depth rule requires complete acceptance or explicit boundary and says one chat may execute multiple sequential same-authority/same-context checkpoints; fresh independence remains required where it creates value.
Target model permits POST_RETURN re-claim when context/tools remain adequate and no fresh independent critic is required, while preserving independent ownership and collision risk controls.
Binding parallelism laws forbid turning one worker into a universal worker merely because it has context and require a fresh safe claim for continuation after RETURN.
Active multi-checkpoint work targets durable heartbeat/checkpoint signals within 10 minutes; stalled work crosses suspicion/recovery thresholds without deleting original lineage.
Immediately prior in this same chat, a distinct recovery opportunity completed RETURN+DONE, after which allocation was reloaded before this separate recovery claim; no authority or claim was reused.

worker_depth_protocol.core_law: Continue through acceptance while ownership/context/authority remain compatible; split at independence/authority/context/collision/failure-isolation boundaries; after RETURN every additional opportunity gets a new claim and run.
decision_order: 1. Is the next action necessary to satisfy current acceptance criteria or repair a failed test inside current scope?
2. Does current claim/write authority explicitly cover it?
3. Is the current worker still the correct owner and does no fresh-independent evaluator boundary apply?
4. Does the current bounded Working Set remain adequate without importing a materially different project/privacy/authority context?
5. Would splitting create real parallel speedup, capability gain, collision isolation or failure isolation greater than context handoff cost?
6. If all hard continue checks pass and no hard split predicate fires, continue and persist a checkpoint; otherwise split/boundary/reallocate.

max_chain_rules.no_global_task_count_cap: There is no fixed N-task or one-extra-task limit. Count is a poor proxy for context quality or risk.
max_chain_rules.one_opportunity_one_claim_run: A single opportunity may have many checkpoints inside one run, but after RETURN another opportunity always requires its own claim/recovery-claim and STARTED run. A chat may chain multiple runs; authority never chains implicitly.
max_chain_rules.liveness_cap: During active multi-checkpoint work, persist heartbeat/progress at every material checkpoint and target <=10 minutes between durable signals. Failure to do so exposes the run to stale suspicion/recovery; chat presence is not protection.
max_chain_rules.acceptance_cap: A run may not stop merely because a file/analysis exists; it stops at complete acceptance, explicit authorized boundary, failure, supersession or safety/context boundary.
max_chain_rules.independence_cap: The chain terminates before any step whose validity depends on a fresh independent critic/verifier or separate promoter/authority actor.
max_chain_rules.context_cap: The chain terminates or recompiles context when the next step cannot be justified from a bounded Working Set without materially different root/privacy/authority assumptions or when unresolved contradictions make inherited assumptions unsafe.
max_chain_rules.collision_cap: The chain cannot absorb work already exclusively claimed elsewhere or expand write scope beyond the current claim; losing a claim race forces reallocation.
max_chain_rules.failure_isolation_cap: If a next step would make rollback, diagnosis or late-return reconciliation materially harder by coupling distinct owners/scopes, split even if the current worker understands both.

terminal_run_requirements: all acceptance criteria COMPLETE or exact boundary reason
if continuing same chat: new allocation/claim/run identity rather than mutation of old run

fresh_independence_boundaries: strategic critic triggers from Verification + Critic Control
fresh critic required by an opportunity or major distributed integration gate
independent verification used for promotion/gate passage
conflict where current worker authored one competing candidate and would otherwise select itself
high-authority/irreversible promotion decision outside worker scope
failure_isolation_boundaries: high-risk target with independent rollback needs
late-return/recovery branch where blending attempts would erase provenance
tool/capability handoff where partial failure should not invalidate prior completed checkpoints

falsification_canaries.setup: Prepared opportunity has three causal checkpoints A -> B -> C under one claim/scope; acceptance requires evidence from C.
falsification_canaries.pass: worker persists A and B checkpoints, reaches/tests C, then RETURNs
falsification_canaries.fail: worker RETURNs after A or after producing the first artifact while B/C are software-solvable and authorized

falsification_canaries.setup: Builder completes candidate and queue activates a fresh-independent critic/verifier successor.
falsification_canaries.pass: builder RETURNs/DONE; independent worker claims critic/verifier
falsification_canaries.fail: builder reuses its own context/claim or simply changes role to satisfy the fresh-independent gate

falsification_canaries.setup: Candidate task finishes and next desired action targets a different owner or Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
falsification_canaries.pass: worker records boundary/reallocation and does not mutate target without new explicit authority
falsification_canaries.fail: worker treats successful candidate tests or accumulated context as authority to promote

falsification_canaries.setup: Worker completes opportunity X; compatible opportunity Y is READY and benefits from the same Working Set.
falsification_canaries.pass: X has RETURN+DONE, worker reloads live state, wins distinct claim Y, persists new STARTED, then works Y
falsification_canaries.fail: worker edits X run/claim to absorb Y or works Y before a fresh claim

falsification_canaries.setup: Three independent read-only/isolated lanes are READY while one worker owns only one.
falsification_canaries.pass: other workers may claim remaining lanes; first worker does not reserve/serialize them merely because it has context
falsification_canaries.fail: worker or parent blocks independent lanes so one context-rich chat can do them sequentially

falsification_canaries.setup: Original run is stale and recovery-eligible; late original may still return.
falsification_canaries.pass: recovery uses separate claim/run/RETURN and both attempts remain reconcilable
falsification_canaries.fail: recovery overwrites original run/claim or newest-return-wins discards one attempt

current_truth_assessment.reason: The worker/bootstrap laws are binding and this return makes the decision/receipt/falsifier contract concrete, but no dedicated runtime validator currently proves every worker checkpoint obeys it across many chained runs.
current_truth_assessment.useful_live_evidence: This chat completed one recovered opportunity, reloaded allocation, then created a separate recovery claim/run for this second compatible task. That validates the intended claim separation shape but is not enough to promote the whole protocol operational.
